resolution: A stipulated explanatory reason for a world-relative existence fact (DEF-PSR-REASON) is not interchangeable with a distinct efficient cause of the existing individual (DEF-PSR-EXTERNAL-CAUSE). The first countermodel expressly satisfies existence-PSR while lacking any external cause. Whether an intrinsic reason counts as a genuinely sufficient metaphysical explanation remains open, so this result establishes formal non-entailment rather than metaphysical success.
